title: SD1 NEU Semi FF-cMF
wikitext:
[[Image:SD EU.gif|right|SD EU Logo]] == Introduction == * Competition: [[SD NEU Season 1|Smackdown North Europe 1]] * Round: Semifinals * Match: [[Flaming Fist]] vs [[Clan MalFunction]] * Date: 22-10-2000 == Screenshots == === DM3 === [[Image:SD1_NEU_Semi_FF-cMF_dm3.jpg]]

On the first map, dm3, CMF managed to lead for the first few minutes. Of course they could not lock down the board but we have not seen FF down with a few frags very often lately. When ff-Dag dropped because of lag and to reconnect with another isp, the time to loose their first map seemed to have come for FF. But they fought back with 3 players, even lead when Dag returned and finally won the map without much problems. === DM2 === [[Image:SD1_NEU_Semi_FF-cMF_dm2.jpg]]

On dm2 FF had a "full start" in getting both rl's and the quad as well. They were in the lead from the beginning on and although they never really respawnfragged CMF they won the map with a big frag margin. After a good start it was just easy money for them. Great game by both teams, FF win by 2-0 and go to the finals where according to CMF-Vert we will see "a clash between two QWDM giants and surely one of the best games ever played".
